population_total_basis: All persons, Bahrain 2020 census (Total 1501635; Bahraini 712362, Non-Bahraini 789273), from the iGA data.gov.bh cut Population by Religion, Nationality and Sex - Census 2020. Under the minority-share two-slot design the two metric slots carry the reference-group (Muslim) share and its exact complement, the minority share (the Others line); the published frame is two lines only (Muslim / Others, مسلم / أخرى) with no no-religion and no not-stated category. The census does not split Muslim into Sunni/Shia.
